title: Glass Garden Living Room
style: warm contemporary residential architecture with pale limestone, oak, sage upholstery, and black metal details
interior_program: a furnished living room with an L-shaped sofa, coffee table, reading chair, media wall, shelving, rug, indoor plants, and a clear central circulation route
exterior_program: a lush private garden courtyard with a stone path connected to the doorway, a timber pergola, bench, layered planters, small trees, and low garden walls
transition: a wide open glazed garden door with a flush threshold connecting the living-room floor directly to the garden path

title: Brick Corner Cafe
style: brick-industrial neighborhood cafe with dark steel, walnut, cream plaster, and muted red accents
interior_program: a cafe with service counter, pastry display, back bar, espresso equipment represented as detailed geometry, small dining tables, chairs, banquette, pendant-like ceiling details, and clear circulation
exterior_program: a pedestrian street corner with continuous paving, curb and road, outdoor cafe tables, planters, bollards, street trees, neighboring facade fragments, and a fabric awning
transition: an open double entrance centered in the storefront, with aligned interior tile and exterior pavement and no step

title: Timber Bookshop and Civic Plaza
style: crafted timber-traditional bookshop with deep blue-green joinery, warm wood, brass details, and stone paving
interior_program: a bookshop with perimeter bookcases containing visible book geometry, central display tables, checkout desk, reading chairs, rugs, plants, and an unobstructed entrance aisle
exterior_program: a compact civic plaza with connected stone paving, circular planter, shade tree, benches, lamp posts, bicycle rack, and restrained neighboring shopfronts
transition: an open recessed timber doorway and short covered entry apron that visibly connects the shop aisle to the plaza

title: Tropical Co-work Courtyard
style: airy tropical-modern coworking lounge with terrazzo, light timber, woven textures expressed geometrically, white plaster, and rich greenery
interior_program: a coworking lounge with communal worktable, chairs, two soft seating clusters, low storage, shelving, acoustic ceiling baffles, plants, and a wide clear route to the exit
exterior_program: a shaded tropical courtyard with flush decking and paving, a narrow reflecting pool away from the walking route, palms, broad-leaf plants, pergola, lounge benches, and a garden wall
transition: a fully open wide sliding-door bay with matching floor levels and a continuous central walkway

title: Industrial Gallery and Arts Lane
style: converted industrial gallery with concrete, weathered brick, black steel, warm plywood, and saturated sculptural accents
interior_program: an art gallery with freestanding sculptural objects, framed abstract wall reliefs without text, display plinths, reception desk, track-light housings, benches, and a clear axial path
exterior_program: an urban arts lane with continuous concrete paving, road edge, graphic color-block wall panels without words, planters, bicycle, utility details, benches, and warehouse facade fragments
transition: a tall open steel-framed loading-bay entrance converted into a public doorway with a flush interior-to-lane threshold

title: Alpine Lodge Terrace
style: refined alpine lodge using stacked stone, dark timber, wool-like soft forms, aged bronze, and muted forest colors
interior_program: a lodge lounge with stone fireplace, sectional seating, armchairs, low tables, dining nook, shelving, rugs, ceiling beams, and an open central route
exterior_program: a mountain terrace and arrival garden with connected stone paving, timber deck, firewood rack, conifers, boulders, benches, lantern fixtures, low walls, and distant stylized mountain forms
transition: an open timber-and-glass terrace doorway with a covered porch and step-free stone path continuing outward
